name: Lockbox Private Safe
subtitle: Secure Photo File Organiser
privacyPolicyText: Lockbox Private Safe protects photos, videos, links, and files that users choose to import. Private content is stored on the user device by default. If iCloud sync is enabled, synced content is encrypted before upload. The developer does not hold decryption keys, does not sell user data, and does not use private content for advertising tracking.
